title: Luceras Head
heading: Luceras: the head
lede: Stage 5 of 11, part 1 of 5. APPROVED by Nick on 2026-10-14 (decision N-f3y7, Claude pass 4, B-rv4f). The torso (part 2) is building in both streams. This page stays as the record; the Codex stream's reconstruction pass is now in section 3 for comparison.

fold.title: Decided by the pipeline owner
fold.text: Both streams were given the same brief twice: first with Blender work only (hand-placed masses), which stalled on the face in both streams, then, after a hold audit, with the face reconstructed from your clay head views and the authored horns, eyes and ears re-seated. That audit result is now a pipeline rule: faces and other soft forms come from reconstruction. The Claude head took four passes: masses (rodent), measured fixes (balloon), reconstruction graft (reads), cleanup. The Codex stream's reconstruction pass (its pass 3) is in section 3 for comparison beside its masses pass. Everything outside the head is unchanged to within 0.6 mm. Costs: Claude about 2 hours 20 minutes wall and about 490K tokens over four passes; Codex pass 2 about 80 minutes wall.

claude.name: Claude stream head (pass 4)
claude.question: Does this head read as the model sheet's head?
judge: Three-quarter: brow, cheekbone, nose bridge, short muzzle as the sheet?
Horns: large, slim, ridged, half-turn, tips turned in, sitting on the skull?
Ears: small, rounded, cupped, behind the horn bases?
Eyes: large, forward, high, seated with lids?
claude.note: Declared leftovers for later stages: two faint nubs per whisker pad at the close side camera, ring-like horn ridges, a soft lid line, placeholder whiskers.

codex.name: Codex stream head (passes 2 and 3)
codex.question: For comparison only.
codex.note: Codex (gpt-6-astra). Pass 3 (B-vh9a) after the same hold audit: the face reconstructed from the clay views, its pass-2 horns, eyes and ears re-seated. My read: a clear step up from its pass 2 (real nasal bridge, cheek plane, small nose) but below the Claude head: the muzzle still runs long, the eyes sit small in flat rings, the horns stay thin and wide-spread. Pass 2 was pure Blender steering: thin wiry horns, bulging eyes, long snout, bulb ears.
